<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_3DModel"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-model">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProjectDraft" name="3D project draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Change request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL file"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Send sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="StartEvent_Artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Send project draft" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="Event_ReceiveProject" messageRef="Message_ProjectDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedDraft" name="Send revised project" sourceRef="Task_SendRevision" targetRef="Event_ReceiveProject" messageRef="Message_ProjectDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangeRequest" name="Send change request" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ReceiveChanges" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Send approval" sourceRef="Task_SendApproval" targetRef="Event_ReceiveApproval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="Send STL file" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Event_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Continuously send printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Create and print a custom 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create a project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches to artist"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveProject" name="Receive project result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveProject" messageRef="Message_ProjectDraft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProject" name="Review project result"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApproval" name="Approve project"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL file">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorAtHome" name="Color at home?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckQuantity" name="Check amount of color left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Under 100 grams?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Merge stock paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PlasticAvailable" name="Merge plastic paths"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printing preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PrintComplete" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Craving" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Event_ReceiveProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_04" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveProject" targetRef="Task_ReviewProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_05" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProject" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_06" name="Not satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_07" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ReceiveProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_08" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendApproval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_09" sourceRef="Task_SendApproval" targetRef="Event_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_CheckQuantity">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">color at home</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_OrderColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">color not at home</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Task_CheckQuantity" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amount under 100 grams</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amount is at least 100 grams</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_17" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_18" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_19" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_20" sourceRef="Gateway_PlasticAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_21" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_22" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_23" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_24" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_25" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_26" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="EndEvent_PrintComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create the 3D project" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Artist" name="Receive sketches and instruction">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArtistStart" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProject" name="Create 3D project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDraft" name="Send project result"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForFeedback" name="Wait for customer response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveChanges" name="Receive change request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveChanges" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveApproval" name="Receive approval">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveApproval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseProject" name="Change project according to feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRevision" name="Send revised project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSTL" name="Send STL file"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ArtistComplete" name="STL file sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Artist" targetRef="Task_CreateProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateProject" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_03" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_04" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForFeedback" targetRef="Event_ReceiveChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_05" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForFeedback" targetRef="Event_ReceiveApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_06" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveChanges" targetRef="Task_ReviseProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_07" sourceRef="Task_ReviseProject" targetRef="Task_SendRevision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_08" sourceRef="Task_SendRevision" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_09" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveApproval" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_10" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="EndEvent_ArtistComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
